1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the preparation and general specifications of hydro-alcoholic extract of Withania somnifera prepared from the dried mature roots of Withania somnifera (L.) (Family- Solanaceae).
REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute the provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards:
